semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Cognex provides machine vision systems and inspection products that are relevant for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Cognex is a leading provider of vision systems, software, and industrial barcode readers that enhance manufacturing automation. Their solutions are utilized for defect detection, production line monitoring, and part identification, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
capabilities: Machine vision systems for defect detection

regional_presence.United States: Cognex is headquartered in Natick, Massachusetts, USA, serving an international customer base.
